_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global automotive industry leader based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford’s current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2014 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global automotive industry leader based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford’s current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2014 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.33x; -1% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.48; conservative 2yr +57%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY15 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.2%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.1-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.8%/yr (FY05-FY15 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +1128.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY15 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2016-02-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.33x (38.9% downside to Bear $7 / +118.3% upside to Bull $25) | Adj composite 3.70 vs market 1.22: gap +2.48 [UNDERVALUED] | -1% above the EPP floor $12 (6x FY16E $1.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: +57.2% total (+28.6%/yr) | At 5.9x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $15 sits at or below the BASE case; wholesale units +12.3% in Q4 2015, forward revenues +12.3% (no Q1 2016 revenue guide, Q4 2015 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
